title: Supply And Demand
description: Interactive simulation for Supply And Demand
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Supply
learningObjectives: Explain why the demand curve slopes downward as price rises on the price-quantity plot
Predict the quantity demanded at a given price by moving the price slider and reading the plotted point
Identify the price and quantity axes and their maximum values on the demand curve graph
Trace how a change in the price slider moves the marker along the demand curve rather than shifting the curve itself
Distinguish a movement along the demand curve caused by price from a shift of the curve caused by non-price factors
